content.comment_body: Hello. I have a [article_no] together with a [article_no] connected. I'm able to program the [article_no] using [product_name] full version [version_no] and a USB cable without issues. I recently connected the [article_no] for the first time and noticed its LED remains on RUN constantly. Should it turn off along with the [article_no]? What is the correct procedure to program the [article_no]?

The [product_name] expansion module does not require separate programming. Simply define the digital inputs and outputs directly in your program: - First input on the expansion module: I9 - Second input: I10 ... - First output on the expansion module: Q5 - Second output: Q6 ... Continue this mapping for additional inputs and outputs.

Hello [user_name], Thank you for your response. I realized the [article_no] was powered by 12 VDC, while the [article_no] had a different 24 VDC supply. Now everything is working as expected—the LEDs are synchronized. I performed some tests and all outputs (Q) are functioning correctly.
